summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Astra, a new flagship model available across ChatGPT tiers and the API, claiming state-of-the-art results on computer-use, coding, reasoning, and science benchmarks with a 1.05M-token context window.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a new flagship model claiming state-of-the-art performance across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, science and professional-work benchmarks, the defining case for this mechanism.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-6 Astra is the most intelligent and aligned model in the world, and sets a new state of the art for computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science, and professional work.

mechanisms.reason: The model spec states a very large 1.05M-token context window, directly increasing per-accelerator memory content for serving.
Immediate rollout to all Pro, Enterprise and Business Premium users plus the API broadens the surface generating tokens at scale.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in ChatGPT Work and Codex. It's also live in the API.

mechanisms.reason: The model is marketed and benchmarked specifically on computer-use and workflow-automation tasks across professions, indicating agent-executed work displacing manual computer operation.
mechanisms.quote: Astra achieves state-of-the-art results on Agents’ Last Exam, AutomationBench, and ScreenSpot Pro, benchmarks for computer workflow tasks across professions.

practices.reason: A frontier release with stated lab benchmark gains on computer-use/agentic tasks, reasoning and coding warrants evaluation before relying on it in production.
